d: Short ash-brown hair with choppy bangs and pointed side tufts frames a youthful face with sharp, golden-yellow eyes. The slender build is encased in polished plate armor featuring a palette of teal, cream, and gold, consisting of a chestplate, flared tassets, and matching greaves. Visible non-human traits include two large, pointed animal ears atop the head with gold jewelry and a fluffy white tail.
